summary: PulseHub Phase 0 backend tested end-to-end via pytest. 42/42 tests passing covering auth (login/me/JWT), RBAC for patients/vitals/prescriptions, severity classification boundary cases (glucose/hr/spo2), AES-GCM field encryption verification in Mongo, WebSocket auth + broadcast for vitals & chat, OpenAPI spec, and idempotent auto-seed. Tests run against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for HTTP and ws://localhost:8001 for WS.

minor.issue: Response objects include MongoDB `_id` field (it is a UUID string so JSON serializes fine, but other endpoints return `id`). Inconsistent shape — consider remapping to `id` for API uniformity.
Email field accepts any string (per design to allow .test TLD); no rate limiting / brute-force lockout implemented in Phase 0. Acceptable for Phase 0 but should be noted for Phase 1.

action_items: (optional) Normalize prescription response to use `id` instead of `_id`.
Phase 1: add login throttling / brute-force lockout, audit log persistence review.
critical_code_review_comments: Severity classifier (risk.py) correctly handles all documented boundaries.
Field-level encryption works: vitals collection stores `value` as base64 (AES-GCM nonce+ct+tag) AND a `value_plain` mirror. The HIPAA trade-off is explicitly documented in hipaa_utils.py.
Auto-seed is idempotent — second startup logged 'skipped: users collection not empty' and run_seed(force=False) returns {skipped: True} without modifying counts.

WebSocket auth via ?token= query param works; missing token returns HTTP 403 during handshake (FastAPI rejects missing required Query before upgrade), valid token sends {type:'ready'} as first message and broadcasts vital events.
JWT uses HS256 with bcrypt password hashing ($2b$ format). get_current_user supports both Bearer header and access_token cookie fallback.
Doctor RBAC scoping verified: dr.smith only sees patients with assigned_doctor_id == smith.id (3 patients); dr.jones sees the other 2; admin sees all 5; patients get 403 on /api/patients.
test_credentials: Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 8 seed accounts confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: No new seed; auto-seed produced 8 users + 3600 vitals + 3 prescriptions on first boot. Tests added a handful of additional vitals during boundary tests (acceptable, ~12+ new docs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses Authorization: Bearer JWTs; email accepts .test TLD via plain str. All routes under /api. WebSockets require ?token=<jwt> query param; missing/invalid token returns HTTP 403 during handshake (not a 1008 close, because the param is declared `Query(...)` required — FastAPI rejects before the upgrade). Tests run via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Mongo verification uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from backend/.env.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all checks pass.
